I have exclusively worked on web applications related to the program:

  • Payroll Transfer Service: Monitoring, correction of failed transfers (typically due to network errors), replacement of PPK keys for SFTP transfers, and communication with MasterCard regarding error cases.

projects.name: Administration System for Private Schools
projects.description:
UVskole is a student administration and financial system aimed at private schools. It is a client/server desktop application written in .NET Framework 4.8 with a Firebird database. The system includes integrations with various services at the Ministry of Education as well as external partners.

My contributions:

  • Front page: Replacement of the old Blogengine.net site with a single page application written in Vue 3, which via the Wordpress API uses a token-based authentication process and ensures access to, for example, guides and videos.
  • Bank integration: Integration with an external service at Dansk Bankintegration including the authentication process; including technical communication with the developer from Dansk Bankintegration.
  • Bank reconciliations and settlements: Window implemented according to the New Accounting Act. Import of CSV files from the bank as well as import via service from Bankintegration.
  • Certificate Archive: Window for viewing and deleting generated certificates.
  • Graduation Certificate Wizard: Added generation of PDF certificates, which are sent to the Certificate Archive.
  • Waiting list setup: Style sheets, welcome text and user-defined texts as well as closing year – i.e. classes per school year that can be closed for registrations.
  • Nemhandel registration: Registration form for Nemhandel.
  • Microsoft Graph API integration: Application setup in Azure and implementation of a window for completing the authentication process, so that a user can log in to their Office 365 account and send emails through UVskole.
  • External Services: Zenbi: Implementation of services regarding synchronization of classes between Zenbi and UVskole. Certificate Archive: Services regarding retrieval of schools, persons and school certificates from UVskole. MSGraphAPI: Service to receive callback from Microsoft in connection with the authentication process in UVskole.
  • 2nd Line Support: Support cases, especially concerning the Waiting List, VoresSkole and Bank integration/Bank reconciliation.

projects.name: Applications for the optical industry
projects.description:
A range of systems serving several hundred Scandinavian opticians. The main product HORIZON is a hybrid desktop application with windows made in Delphi, .Net (WPF) and web views (CEF and Typescript Angular). Here I have worked on the following applications:

  • Web Booking (2019-2022): Appointment booking system for opticians' customers; e.g. eye exams etc. I have developed the application from scratch in Angular, and it is currently used by more than 200 stores in Denmark, Sweden, Greenland and the Faroe Islands.
  • Web Admin (2020-2022): Account management page that controls user access, mobile user access, design, opening hours, preferred language, and several other aspects related to customers' Web Booking. Likewise an application I have developed from scratch.
  • HORIZON (2020-22): Web windows developed in Angular for handling employees, appointment types, examination rooms, appointment calendar, customers, suppliers, third-party payers, closing days, reconciliation of postings, and frame and lens cards. Furthermore, I have handled language management on the project (XLIFF).
  • Web Share (2020-22): Repo with Npm packages, including styles, assets, components and other code shared between several web projects.
  • Storelist Editor (2020-2021): Small application for internal use regarding the creation, updating and synchronization of stores.
  • Cloud API (2021-2022): API for Authentication and settings for cloud apps. The API is hosted on Azure and ensures secure communication between the cloud and the stores' backend for frontend (BFF) regarding e.g. appointment bookings.
  • Microservices (2020-2022): A number of RESTful web services developed in ASP .NET Core for handling customers, appointments, inventory management, sales, eye exams etc. I have worked on several of these services, as well as developed some of them from scratch.
  • HORIZON Mobile (2020-2022): Progressive Web App (PWA) developed in Angular for handling opticians' appointments. Here I have, among other things, handled authentication with JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
